about_the_game:
Record Rewind Repeat is a mind-bending puzzle-platformer that tests your timing, logic, and reflexes. Navigate 50 meticulously crafted levels where every move matters. Use a unique time-recording mechanic to create duplicates of yourself and work together across time to overcome intricate puzzles and platforming challenges.

Key Features:

  • Innovative Time Manipulation Gameplay: Record your actions, rewind to the past, and collaborate with your time-duplicates to solve puzzles.

  • 50 Handcrafted Levels: Each level introduces new mechanics and challenges, testing your logic, timing, and platforming precision.

  • Simple to Learn, Hard to Master: Intuitive controls make it accessible to all players, while the puzzles grow in complexity to keep you engaged.

  • Minimalistic 3D Art Style: A clean, distraction-free visual aesthetic that highlights the puzzles and gameplay.

  • For All Ages: Perfect for kids, adults, and anyone who loves puzzles and platformers.

Plan your moves, strategize your actions, and execute perfectly timed maneuvers to solve challenging puzzles and achieve success. Whether you're a casual player looking for a fun challenge or a puzzle enthusiast seeking your next obsession, Record Rewind Repeat offers an experience you won't forget.

Can you master time and logic to conquer all 50 levels?

Wishlist now and start your time-manipulating journey!
